children: Argentina's government presented its 2027 budget proposal to Congress on Tuesday, laying out President Javier Milei's economic projections and spending priorities ahead of a presidential election next year.

According to the bill, the government forecasts GDP growth of 4% in 2027 and expects Argentina to record a trade surplus of over $15 billion next year. The budget proposal also forecast inflation to average 21.1% in 2027.
